SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('day', datetime) AS "time",
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_power END, daily_power) AS "Power Consumption (kWh)"
FROM user_powermeterreadingdata
WHERE form_id = 709
  AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
ORDER BY "time";

WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',  
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',    
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_readings AS (
    SELECT
        (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN is_override THEN reset_value
            ELSE daily_flow
        END AS daily_flow
    FROM
        user_flowmeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 724
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),
daily_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        ds.date,
        dr.daily_flow AS daily_consumption
    FROM
        date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN 
        daily_readings dr ON ds.date = dr.date
    WHERE
        ds.date >= (CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date 
        AND ds.date < (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
)
SELECT
    date,
    SUM(daily_consumption) AS "Inlet Flow Meter"
FROM
    daily_consumption
GROUP BY
    date
ORDER BY
    date;

WITH inlet AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', datetime) AS day,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_flow END, daily_flow) AS flow
  FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE form_id = 724 AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),
power AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', datetime) AS day,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_power END, daily_power) AS power
  FROM user_powermeterreadingdata
  WHERE form_id = 709 AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
)
SELECT
  inlet.day AS "time",
  CASE
    WHEN power.power IS NULL OR power.power = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (inlet.flow / power.power)
  END AS "Power Intensity (m³/kWh)"
FROM inlet
JOIN power ON inlet.day = power.day
ORDER BY "time";

WITH permeate AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS day,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_flow END, daily_flow) AS flow
  FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE form_id = 726 AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),
feed AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS day,
    COALESCE(CASE WHEN is_override THEN reset_value ELSE daily_flow END, daily_flow) AS flow
  FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE form_id = 733 AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
)
SELECT
  permeate.day AS "time",
  CASE
    WHEN feed.flow IS NULL OR feed.flow = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (permeate.flow / feed.flow) * 100.0
  END AS "% Recovery"
FROM permeate
JOIN feed ON permeate.day = feed.day
ORDER BY "time";

WITH date_series AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',  
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata',    
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_chem AS (
    SELECT
        c.date,
        m.chemical_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.consumption > 0 THEN c.consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption
    FROM user_chemicalstocktrackerdata c
    JOIN user_chemicalmasterdata m 
      ON LOWER(c.chemical_name) = LOWER(m.chemical_name)
     AND m.team_id = 396
     AND m.is_active = true
    WHERE
        c.form_id = 741
        AND $__timeFilter(c.date)
    GROUP BY
        c.date,
        m.chemical_name
)
SELECT
    ds.date::timestamp AS "time",
    COALESCE(dc.consumption, 0) AS "value",
    dc.chemical_name AS "metric"
FROM date_series ds
JOIN daily_chem dc ON ds.date = dc.date
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(ds.date)
    AND ds.date >= (CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
    AND ds.date <= (CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamptz) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date
ORDER BY
    ds.date ASC,
    dc.chemical_name ASC;
